planets.name: HD 207897 b
planets.description: HD 207897 b crosses its star every 16.2 days and is 2.3 times as wide as Earth, found in 2021.

text.card: HD 207897 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 207897. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
